title: Migrate opportunity validation rules from VRL to a Python validation module
target_requirement: Reimplement the seven OPP_MASTER validation rules (OPP-001..OPP-007) as a Python module exposing validate(record, old, event, today) that returns all failed-rule errors in rule-file order, preserving VRL semantics: collect-all (no short-circuit across rules), empty-string-to-zero numeric coercion, the 00000000 date sentinel, NVL defaults, event filtering (INSERT vs UPDATE), and BLOCK vs WARN severity.
expected_behavior: validate() returns [] for compliant records; returns one error dict per failed rule with the legacy error code, message, and severity; WARN failures are reported but is_blocked() is False when only WARN failures occur; OLD.* references resolve to the pre-update image and to empty string on INSERT.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §2).
security_expectations: No network access; no execution of rule text via eval/exec on untrusted strings is required by tests, but the module must not import network or subprocess modules.
failure_conditions: Short-circuiting after the first BLOCK failure; dropping WARN severity; treating the 00000000 sentinel as a comparable date; firing UPDATE-only rules on INSERT.
